summary: A thin day: tour-level tennis (WTA Beijing R16/QF, ATP Shanghai R1) and two ESL Pro League CS2 elimination deciders make up the kept legs, all trimmed slightly for fatigue, poor form or bad head-to-heads. Excluded legs are Challenger tennis, tier-2 LoL events and an NBA preseason game.

verdicts.reason: FURIA (HLTV #4) vs 9z (#16), regular fives, both 2-2 so the winner reaches the Spodek playoffs (dust2.us, Liquipedia, HLTV news 45659); but FURIA lost 3 of last 5 series incl. 1-2 to Aurora yesterday (HLTV 45656) and 9z are 3-1 on Mirage here, so trim 2.
verdicts.main_risk: 9z take a decider on Mirage or Dust2 while FURIA's form keeps sliding.

verdicts.reason: NaVi (HLTV #10) vs PARIVISION (#20), both 2-2 in a decider; NaVi in a slump with no top-8 finish since May (HLTV 45659) and played a late overtime decider vs Falcons last night (HLTV 45660), while PARIVISION beat G2 and pushed Spirit and FURIA; regular lineups (dust2.us, navi.gg).
verdicts.main_risk: A tired, slumping NaVi lose on Ancient or Inferno, where PARIVISION are 2-1 at this event.
